Navigation

Tabs

Pill tab bar for switching sections. Implements the ARIA tablist pattern: roving tabIndex, aria-selected, and Left/Right/Home/End keyboard navigation. The tab list scrolls sideways inside itself on narrow screens. Class contract: .rse-tabs, __list, __tab, __panel.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Pill tab bar for switching between sections (program levels, unit locations).

const [tab, setTab] = React.useState('infantil');
<Tabs tabs={[{id:'infantil',label:'Educação Infantil'},{id:'fundamental',label:'Ensino Fundamental'}]} activeId={tab} onChange={setTab} />

Implements the ARIA tablist pattern: the bar is a role="tablist", each pill a role="tab" with aria-selected, and only the active tab is in the tab order (Left/Right/Home/End move between tabs). Give each tab a panelId and put role="tabpanel" + aria-labelledby="tab-<id>" on the panel you render below, so the pair is announced as one widget. Pass label to name the bar ("Níveis de ensino").

On narrow screens the tab list scrolls sideways inside its own container (nothing is hidden and the page never overflows); the list is padded so the focus ring is never clipped. Extra props and className go on the outer .rse-tabs element, and a ref points at it.

Plain HTML (CSS contract, no JavaScript needed for the look; wire aria-selected, tabindex and hidden yourself):

<div class="rse-tabs">
  <div class="rse-tabs__list" role="tablist" aria-label="Níveis de ensino">
    <button class="rse-tabs__tab" type="button" role="tab" id="tab-infantil" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="painel-infantil">Educação Infantil</button>
    <button class="rse-tabs__tab" type="button" role="tab" id="tab-fundamental" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="painel-fundamental" tabindex="-1">Ensino Fundamental</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="rse-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="painel-infantil" aria-labelledby="tab-infantil">…</div>
<div class="rse-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="painel-fundamental" aria-labelledby="tab-fundamental" hidden>…</div>

Component tokens

Set any of these on :root or an ancestor to re-skin Tabs without touching its CSS. Each defaults to a role token, so it follows the theme. Use a role or palette token as the new value, and keep its pairs in scripts/contrast-pairs.mjs passing.

TokenDefaultLightDarkContrast
--rse-tabs-active-bg{rse.color.surface-card}#ffffff#24232f#ffffff
--rse-tabs-active-fg{rse.color.primary}#6c62c4#8e82d8#4a3fa8
--rse-tabs-fg{rse.color.text-muted}#615d4f#9b998f#3d3b4a
--rse-tabs-fg-hover{rse.color.text-heading}#2b2a3d#f4f3ee#000000
--rse-tabs-radius{rse.radius.pill}999px999px999px
--rse-tabs-track-bg{rse.color.surface-sunken}#f2f1ec#2e2d3b#f2f1ec
